policy:
# Dogwatch sandbox policy. Field names follow docs/how-it-works/policies/schema.mdx in NVIDIA/OpenShell.
# Status: written from the schema, not yet applied (see PLATFORM_PROBE.md).
version: 1
filesystem_policy:
  read_only: [/usr, /etc, /lib, /vault]
  read_write: [/sandbox, /tmp]
process:
  run_as_user: sandbox
  run_as_group: sandbox
network_middlewares:
  dogwatch-seal:
    name: Dogwatch Seal
    middleware: dogwatch-seal
    order: 10
    on_error: fail_closed
    endpoints:
      include: [api.tokenfactory.nebius.com, integrate.api.nvidia.com, api.tavily.com, host.openshell.internal]
network_policies:
  token-factory:
    name: Nebius Token Factory chat only
    endpoints:
      - host: api.tokenfactory.nebius.com
        port: 443
        protocol: rest
        enforcement: enforce
        rules:
          - allow: { method: POST, path: /v1/chat/completions }
          - allow: { method: GET, path: /v1/models }
    binaries: [{ path: /sandbox/.venv/bin/python3 }, { path: /usr/bin/python3 }, { path: /usr/bin/curl }]
  nvidia-api-catalog:
    name: NVIDIA API Catalog chat only (development route)
    endpoints:
      - host: integrate.api.nvidia.com
        port: 443
        protocol: rest
        enforcement: enforce
        rules:
          - allow: { method: POST, path: /v1/chat/completions }
          - allow: { method: GET, path: /v1/models }
    binaries: [{ path: /sandbox/.venv/bin/python3 }, { path: /usr/bin/python3 }, { path: /usr/bin/curl }]
  tavily:
    name: Tavily search and extract
    endpoints:
      - host: api.tavily.com
        port: 443
        protocol: rest
        enforcement: enforce
        rules:
          - allow: { method: POST, path: /search }
          - allow: { method: POST, path: /extract }
    binaries: [{ path: /sandbox/.venv/bin/python3 }, { path: /usr/bin/python3 }, { path: /usr/bin/curl }]
  radio-officer:
    name: Radio Officer drafts and questions
    endpoints:
      - host: host.openshell.internal
        port: 8787
        protocol: rest
        enforcement: enforce
        rules:
          - allow: { method: POST, path: /drafts }
          - allow: { method: POST, path: /questions }
          - allow: { method: GET, path: /inbox }
          - allow: { method: POST, path: /vault/identifiers }
    binaries: [{ path: /sandbox/.venv/bin/python3 }, { path: /usr/bin/python3 }, { path: /usr/bin/curl }]
